spec.scene: Devon asks if the user wants pizza this Friday after work. They settle the details without recapping other chats.
facts: Devon and the user agree to Friday pizza at 7 pm at Rosa's on Oak Street.

dialogue: Devon: you done with dinner yet
Me: yeah just finished the leftover chicken
Devon: that lemon pepper stuff from yesterday?
Me: yep still pretty good reheated
Devon: nice, i just had cereal again lol
Me: classic lazy dinner
Devon: fr, hey you wanna do pizza this Friday after work
Me: oh yeah i'm down, where you thinking
Devon: have you been to Rosa's on Oak Street?
Me: no but i've heard the name, is it good?
Devon: yeah my coworker keeps raving about it
Me: what kind of pizza do they do?
Devon: like thin crust, wood fired or something
Me: oh that sounds good actually
Devon: wanna try it Friday?
Me: yeah let's do it, what time?
Devon: is 7 pm too late for you?
Me: no 7 works perfect for me
Devon: cool, we can meet at Rosa's?
Me: yeah on Oak Street right?
Devon: yep that's the one, parking in the back i think
Me: ok cool, i'll come straight from the office
Devon: same, traffic on 5th is still a mess tho
Me: ugh still? i have to go that way tomorrow
Devon: yeah by the bank still blocked, leave early
Me: i will, did you ever do that autopay thing
Devon: yeah finally did it last night lol
Me: nice, no more late fees
Devon: hopefully, my laptop was being so slow
Me: mine always freezes when i need it most
Devon: right? so Friday at 7 still good?
Me: yep i'm in
Devon: perfect, you talk to your mom today?
Me: no wait your mom? lol
Devon: no i meant yours, sorry that was random
Me: oh nah not today, why?
Devon: just wondering, mine asked about you again
Me: aww tell her i said hi, how'd the groceries go?
Devon: oh that's Saturday, haven't gone yet
Me: oh right, you helping her in the afternoon
Devon: yeah, she already made a list like a mile long
Me: lol of course, need a ride or anything?
Devon: nah i got it, but thanks
Me: ok, cat is currently sitting on my laundry btw
Devon: hahaha clean or dirty?
Me: clean of course, that's why it's annoying
Devon: mine did laps this morning again, no chill
Me: they never learn
Devon: so you good with Rosa's? never been so wanna make sure
Me: yeah sounds great, excited to try it
Devon: same, coworker said get the margherita
Me: oh i love a good margherita
Devon: ok let's do Friday then, i'll text when i'm leaving work
Me: sounds good, i'll do the same
cost_note: API did not report a charge
